description: This file contains functions for processing documentation files with frontmatter and body sections, translating their contents, and managing file state to avoid redundant translations. It mainly facilitates reading, parsing, translating, and writing structured documentation, with detailed handling of frontmatter markers and hashing to detect changes.

methods.name: processFileDoc
methods.description: Main function to process and translate a documentation file, handle frontmatter, check for changes, and write output.

methods.name: splitFrontMatter
methods.description: Splits the file content into frontmatter and body sections based on custom tags.

methods.name: buildFrontmatterTemplate
methods.description: Builds a frontmatter template with placeholders for translation, marking sections with unique markers.

methods.name: applyFrontmatterTranslations
methods.description: Replaces original frontmatter values with translated ones based on markers.

methods.name: parseTaggedDocument
methods.description: Parses the translated document to extract frontmatter and body sections.

methods.name: formatTaggedDocument
methods.description: Formats frontmatter and body into a tagged document string.

methods.name: trimTagNewlines
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing newlines from a string.

methods.name: extractMarkerValue
methods.description: Extracts the value enclosed between specific start and end markers within the text.

methods.name: setReadWhenValue
methods.description: Updates the 'read_when' array with a new value at a specified index.

methods.name: shouldSkipDoc
methods.description: Determines if a document should be skipped based on source hash comparison.

methods.name: resolveDocsPath
methods.description: Resolves absolute and relative paths for documentation files.
